note: Detection rules over the security events the service and the sign-in path emit (ADR-038): authentication failures and successes, each with the caller's network prefix (/24 or /48) and a keyed fingerprint of the presented credential. Added after the credential-stuffing incident of 2 February 2027 (Chapter 16). Evaluated every 5 minutes with a 28-day baseline, like agent-detection-v1.

rules.title: Authentication failure surge
rules.response: page the security on-call; check SD-002 and SD-003 for the same window

rules.title: Many credentials tried from one network
rules.response: page the security on-call; tighten the sign-in limit for the network (approval-gated)

rules.title: Successful sign-in from a network with many failures
rules.response: page the security on-call; the account is a possible takeover: end its sessions and force a password reset, which also revokes its personal tokens
